轰然巨鸣响彻长白山腹地峡谷，两股截然不同的狂暴力量狠狠撞在一起，金色道韵屏障、湮灭劲气与微弱雷光凝聚的防御阵线，直面甲贺凌厉刀气、九菊血色咒力、阴阳寮迷幻神魂之力的联合冲击。磅礴气浪以碰撞点为核心骤然炸开，环形冲击波横扫四方大地，地面厚实岩层被硬生生碾出数道深浅沟壑，棱角锋利的碎石伴随着炸裂劲风漫天飞溅，粗壮千年古木主干剧烈摇晃，枝桠断裂纷飞，枯黄叶片混杂尘土血雾弥漫整片空域。

749局七人身躯齐齐向后踉跄滑退，脚下地面被鞋底摩擦带出长长泥痕，每一个人的躯体都在强悍冲击力撼动下剧烈震颤，体内翻涌的血气不受控制直冲咽喉，众人死死咬紧牙关，硬生生将喷涌到嘴边的血水强行吞咽压制，不肯在敌人面前流露分毫颓势。

最前方伫立的杨瑞承受冲击力度最为沉重，胸腹原本早已崩裂的伤口再度被巨力撕扯扩大，滚烫鲜血顺着躯干不断往下流淌，迅速浸透内层衣料，黏腻血液紧贴皮肉，每一次呼吸起伏都会带来撕裂般钻心剧痛。盘踞在丹田深处的血色邪咒借着外力冲击疯狂躁动肆虐，阴冷邪气顺着周身经脉飞速窜动，不断啃噬损耗残存本源气力，原本尚能勉强调动的湮灭之力此刻紊乱涣散，凝聚不出完整攻防劲力。他垂落的左臂皮肉外翻，伤口处血肉模糊，神经末梢传来阵阵麻木刺痛，整条臂膀几乎彻底失去行动掌控能力，唯有一双眼眸依旧死死圆睁，猩红目光牢牢锁死迎面而来的一众甲贺忍者，身躯如同扎根山石的苍松，任凭冲击撼动始终未曾屈膝半步。

身侧的范梦雪肩头、腰腹多处旧伤同步开裂，体表细密血珠不断渗出汇聚成流，曾经能够催动雷光道法的经脉此刻干涩滞涩，灵力储备彻底见底，周身再也无法萦绕半分电光。接连不断的高强度鏖战耗尽她全部体能，四肢筋骨酸胀发软，双腿微微颤抖，站立的姿态已然难以保持平稳，可她依旧下意识绷紧全身肌肉，双臂架起格挡姿态，时刻防备敌人趁势突进突袭，涣散的目光一点点重新凝聚锋芒，绝境之下不肯放弃分毫防守阵地。

居中搀扶胡九郎的钱丹同样被气浪掀得身形歪斜，肩头贯穿伤崩开范围再度扩大，大量失血让她脑部供氧持续不足，眼前景象时不时浮现重影眩晕，脑袋昏沉发胀，思维反应速度较之巅峰状态迟缓不少。她下意识收紧手臂力度稳稳托住身旁气息微弱的胡九郎，指尖触碰到对方冰冷发烫的肌肤，心中忧虑愈发浓重。胡九郎经脉多处断裂破损，道力彻底枯竭沉寂，周身金色道韵光芒暗淡稀薄，仅余下一丝微弱精神意识勉强维系清醒，身躯沉重无力，浑身皮肉遍布磕碰挫伤，每一寸肌体都充斥着难以忍受的酸痛，可他依旧拼尽残存心神，运转道眼扫视全场战局，捕捉敌方阵型破绽与气息流动轨迹，低声断续开口传递关键讯息。

“左侧咒力衔接空隙……右侧忍者阵型松动……切勿抱团死守死位，借地形错位周旋拉扯……”

微弱沙哑的话语穿透嘈杂风声厮杀声，清晰送入每一名队员耳中。后方三名少女相互倚靠支撑身形，王欣欣神魂接连遭受冲击震荡，识海之内轰鸣不止，尖锐刺痛连绵不绝，破解幻境的精神本源损耗惨重，视线频繁扭曲晃动，只能勉强分辨近处人影轮廓，大范围气息探查已然无力施展。李安琪体内水系灵力消耗殆尽，脏腑在力量对冲中受到震荡损伤，胸腔闷堵压抑，呼吸短促急促，再也无法凝聚水汽屏障形成防护。茉沫麾下蛊虫彻底消亡，自身心神也因接连苦战紧绷到极限，身心双重疲惫席卷全身，只能凭借本能紧贴同伴，警惕周遭随时可能出现的偷袭杀机。

对面三方围攻阵营同样没能在此次力量碰撞中全身而退，联合攻势被硬生生阻拦击溃，反噬之力反向席卷袭来，诸多参战人员纷纷中招负伤，整体战力同步出现明显下滑。

冲锋在前的甲贺忍者首当其冲承受防御反击的劲浪冲击，数名靠前的忍者躲闪不及，被飞溅碎石与溃散气劲狠狠扫中躯体，胸腹气血翻涌紊乱，接连踉跄后退数步，手中忍刀握持不稳，刀柄震颤晃动，个别伤势较轻的忍者手臂被碎石划伤，鲜血顺着刀柄滴落地面。甲贺忍首立于阵型中段，凭借深厚修为稳稳抵住反噬冲击，面色阴沉冷峻，目光死死盯着中央顽强抵抗的小队，心底怒意与忌惮交织缠绕。他清楚眼前这支看似残破的队伍韧性远超预估，数次致命攻势都没能将其彻底击溃，反而己方接连出现人员损耗，再继续贸然无脑强攻，只会让麾下战力不断折损。

后方施法的九菊阴阳师群体气息普遍起伏紊乱，方才全力催动的血色咒术被正面击溃瓦解，咒力反噬顺着施法脉络回流体内，不少年岁偏大的修士脏腑遭受内伤，面色变得灰败暗沉，双手结印动作僵硬迟缓，短时间内难以再度凝聚高阶杀伤咒法。几名年轻弟子定力不足，被反噬煞气侵入经脉，体表浮现淡淡乌黑淤痕，身体出现酸软无力的不良反应，只能暂时退出施法阵列，原地调息压制体内躁动邪气。

最外围掌控幻境的阴阳寮修士眉头紧紧蹙起，铺开的大范围迷幻领域在两股力量碰撞中大面积破碎崩塌，构筑幻境消耗的神魂之力付诸东流，精神层面传来阵阵疲惫酸痛，再度重塑幻境需要耗费更多本源心神。众人彼此对视，皆能从对方眼底看见凝重之色，原本以为可以轻松碾压剿灭残敌，现实战况却朝着僵持缠斗的方向不断偏移，预想中的速战速决彻底落空。

短暂的力量对冲过后，狂暴气浪缓缓消散，山林间烟尘慢慢沉降，地面狼藉破败，断裂兵器、散落咒符、破碎残叶遍布视野，双方人员各自稳住身形，新一轮贴身缠斗立刻无缝衔接，没有丝毫喘息休整的空隙。

甲贺忍首压下心中焦躁，迅速调整作战部署，放弃大范围集体猛攻模式，拆分麾下忍者为数支小型突袭小队，两两配合、远近呼应，依托密林树木、凸起岩石作为掩护，采用游走突袭、分割骚扰的战术，不再正面硬抗小队合力防御，转而不断寻找防守薄弱点位发起刁钻进攻。数道黑衣身影借助地形隐蔽身形，脚步轻盈落地无声，身形飘忽不定，忍刀寒芒时不时从树木间隙、岩石后方骤然闪出，朝着小队周身死角、负伤部位精准刺击，攻势刁钻阴险，防不胜防。

九菊阴阳师放弃大规模毁灭咒术轰击，转而切换成细密连绵的侵蚀咒力，一道道纤细血色咒丝如同蛛网般漫天飘散，顺着空气缝隙不断渗透逼近，不追求瞬间重创杀敌，而是持续缠绕侵蚀队员经脉皮肉，一点点消磨残存体力与自愈能力，逐步瓦解全员作战根基。丝丝缕缕的阴冷煞气附着在衣物肌肤之上，带来刺骨寒凉与轻微腐蚀痛感，不断干扰众人心神稳定。

阴阳寮修士吸取幻境破碎的教训，不再构建覆盖全场的巨型幻境，转而拆分出无数小型迷惑虚影，零散分布在战场各个角落，真假人影交错闪现，不断扰乱众人视线判断，时不时制造虚假攻击动静，迫使队员频繁分心戒备，无谓消耗精神气力，拖垮整体防守节奏。

多重战术层层叠加施压，白山峡谷内的缠斗瞬间变得错综复杂。小队众人伤势缠身、气力匮乏，只能依托脚下崎岖地形，按照胡九郎指引的方位不断错位移动，彼此之间始终保持呼应距离，既能相互驰援救助，又不会被敌方突袭力量一次性围困分割。

杨瑞拖着负伤身躯游走阵型正面，专门拦截冲杀而来的忍者小队，每当黑衣身影骤然现身，他便咬紧牙关调动体内仅剩的微薄力量，以沉重拳脚格挡反击。湮灭之力残缺不全，打出的攻势威力大打折扣，无法一击制敌，只能凭借强悍肉身抗性硬生生抵挡刀刃劈刺，皮肉不断增添崭新伤口，鲜血浸染范围持续扩大，每一次挥拳抬脚都要忍受极致痛楚，却始终死死守住正面第一道防线，不让敌人突破逼近队内核心。

范梦雪游走侧翼方位，灵活身形穿梭在树木岩石之间，凭借丰富战斗经验预判虚影真假，及时规避幻境迷惑与咒丝缠绕，一旦发现敌方露出进攻破绽，立刻抓住短暂空隙近身冲撞干扰，打乱敌人出招节奏，侧面分担正面防守压力。她动作幅度不敢过大，生怕拉扯开裂更多伤口，攻防之间进退有度，以巧劲周旋消耗敌方精力。

钱丹一边时刻留意胡九郎身体状态，一边目光扫视全场各处厮杀点位，凭借医者敏锐观察力，快速判断敌我伤势轻重变化，同时捡拾地面掉落的细小尖锐碎石，找准敌人经脉穴位间隙精准投掷，以微弱牵制手段干扰敌方施法与出招，力所能及阻拦敌军进攻步伐。

内侧三名少女各司其职，王欣欣拼尽剩余精神感知，剔除虚假幻象干扰，精准提示真实敌人出没方位；李安琪感应周遭稀薄水汽，凝聚细碎水珠阻拦近身的咒丝煞气；茉沫紧盯地面动静，留意敌人脚下走位规律，提前预警潜藏陷阱风险。

三方敌军轮番发起攻势，突袭、咒蚀、幻扰三种攻击方式交替不停，小队全员咬牙坚守防线，格挡、闪避、牵制、反击循环往复。每一次兵刃相撞都会增添新的创伤，每一回咒力侵蚀都会损耗残存体魄，敌我双方人员数量稳步缩减，负伤人员越来越多，战场之上惨叫声、兵刃碰撞声、咒术低吟声连绵不绝，鲜血不断滴落浸润山石泥土，整片白山战地伤势层层累加，厮杀拉扯陷入漫长胶着状态。

谁都无法轻易冲破对方防守阵线，谁也没能占据绝对碾压优势，底牌后手依旧暗藏未动，主力核心战力尚且保存实力没有全力爆发，激烈缠斗还在不断延续，距离最终决战时刻依旧有着一段距离，白山山林间的血腥博弈，依旧在步步升级之中。

A loud roar resounded through the canyon in the hinterland of Changbai Mountain, and two completely different violent forces collided fiercely. The golden Dao Yun barrier, the annihilation energy and the weak thunder light condensed the defensive front, facing the combined impact of Koga's sharp sword energy, Jiuju's bloody spell power, and the psychedelic soul power of Yin Yang Liao.The majestic air wave suddenly exploded with the collision point as the core, and the circular shock wave swept across the land in all directions. The thick rock formations on the ground were forcibly crushed into several deep and shallow ravines. Sharp-edged gravel flew into the sky with the blasting wind. The trunk of the thick thousand-year-old tree shook violently, branches broke and flew, and withered yellow leaves mixed with dust and blood mist filled the entire airspace.

The bodies of the seven people in the 749 round stumbled backwards, and long mud marks were left on the ground under their feet by the friction of their soles. Each person's body was shaken violently by the powerful impact, and the blood surging in the body was uncontrollable and rushed straight into the throat. Everyone gritted their teeth and swallowed the blood that spurted to their mouths to suppress it, unwilling to show any signs of weakness in front of the enemy.

Yang Rui, who was standing at the front, suffered the heaviest impact. The wounds on his chest and abdomen that had already collapsed were torn open and widened by the huge force. Hot blood continued to flow down his torso, quickly soaking into the inner layer of clothing. The sticky blood clung to the skin, and every rise and fall of his breath caused heartbreaking pain like tearing.The blood-colored evil curse entrenched in the depths of the Dantian is raging crazily and violently through the impact of external forces. The cold evil energy moves rapidly along the meridians of the whole body, constantly eating away at the remaining original strength. The power of annihilation that could still be barely mobilized is now chaotic and scattered, and it is impossible to gather complete offensive and defensive strength.The skin and flesh of his hanging left arm were everted, the wound was bloody, numbness and tingling came from the nerve endings, and the entire arm almost completely lost the ability to control movement. Only one pair of eyes were still wide open, and the scarlet gaze firmly locked on the oncoming Koga ninjas. His body was like a pine rooted in the mountain rock, and it never bent even half a step despite the impact.

Fan Mengxue's old wounds on her shoulders, waist and abdomen were simultaneously cracking open at the side. Fine blood beads on her body were seeping out and forming streams. The meridians that were once able to activate the Thunder Light Taoist technique were now dry and stagnant. Her spiritual power reserves had completely bottomed out, and there was no longer any lightning around her body.The continuous high-intensity battles exhausted all her physical energy. Her limbs and muscles were swollen and weak, and her legs were shaking slightly. She could no longer maintain a stable standing posture. However, she still subconsciously tightened her muscles and raised her arms to block, always guarding against the enemy taking advantage of the situation. Her distracted eyes gradually regained their focus, and she refused to give up any defensive position in desperate situations.

Qian Dan, who was helping Hu Jiulang in the middle, was also tilted by the air wave. The scope of the collapse of the penetrating shoulder injury expanded again. The massive blood loss continued to cause insufficient oxygen supply to her brain. The scene in front of her often showed double images and vertigo. Her head was dizzy and swollen, and her thinking and reaction speed was much slower than her peak state.She subconsciously tightened her arms to firmly support the weak Hu Jiulang next to her. Her fingertips touched his cold and hot skin, and her worries became more and more intense.Hu Jiulang's meridians were broken in many places, and his Dao power was completely exhausted and silent. The golden Dao charm around his body was dim and thin, with only a faint mental consciousness left to barely stay awake. His body was heavy and weak, and the flesh all over his body was bruised and bruised. Every inch of his body was filled with unbearable soreness. However, he still used his remaining energy to scan the entire battle with his Dao eyes, capturing the flaws in the enemy's formation and the flow of breath, and spoke intermittently to deliver key messages in a low voice.

"There is a gap in the connection of the magic power on the left side... The ninja formation on the right side is loose... Do not stick to the dead position and take advantage of the dislocation of the terrain..."

The weak and hoarse words penetrated the noisy wind and fighting sounds and were clearly sent to the ears of every team member.The three girls in the back leaned on each other to support their bodies. Wang Xinxin's soul was shocked and shocked one after another. The sea of ​​consciousness roared incessantly and the sharp pains continued. The spiritual source of breaking through the illusion was greatly depleted. Her vision was frequently distorted and shaken. She could barely distinguish the outline of nearby figures, and it was no longer possible to detect the presence of large-scale breaths.The water spiritual power in Li Anqi's body was exhausted, her internal organs were concussively damaged in the force confrontation, her chest was stuffy and depressed, her breathing was short and rapid, and she could no longer condense the water vapor barrier to form a protection.The Gu insects under Momo's command were completely wiped out, and his own mind was strained to the limit due to the continuous hard battles. Both physical and mental exhaustion swept through his body. He could only rely on instinct to stick to his companions and be wary of sneak attacks and murderous intentions that might appear around him at any time.

The three opposing siege camps also failed to retreat from this collision of forces. The joint offensive was blocked and defeated, and the backlash swept back. Many combatants were injured one after another, and the overall combat power simultaneously declined significantly.

The charging Koga ninjas were the first to bear the brunt of the defensive counterattack. Several ninjas in front were unable to dodge, and were hit hard by the flying gravel and the dissipated energy. The blood in the chest and abdomen was turbulent, and they staggered back a few steps. The Ninja sword in their hands was unstable, and the handle shook. Some ninjas with minor injuries were scratched on their arms by the gravel, and blood dripped down the handle of the sword to the ground.The leader of the Koga Ninja stood in the middle of the formation, relying on his profound cultivation to steadily withstand the backlash. His face was gloomy and stern, his eyes fixed on the stubbornly resisting team in the center, with anger and fear intertwined in his heart.He knew that the resilience of the seemingly broken team in front of him was far greater than expected. Several deadly offensives failed to completely defeat it. On the contrary, he suffered successive casualties in personnel. If he continued to attack recklessly and without thought, his combat power would only continue to suffer.

The auras of the Jiuju Onmyoji who were casting spells from behind were generally fluctuating and chaotic. The blood-colored spell that had just been fully activated was defeated and disintegrated from the front. The spell power backfired and flowed back into the fluid along the veins of the spell. Many older monks suffered internal injuries, and their complexions became gray and gloomy. The hand seal movements were stiff and slow, and it was difficult to condense high-level killing spells again in a short period of time.Several young disciples lacked concentration, and the evil energy invaded their meridians. Light black bruises appeared on the body surface, and the body suffered from adverse reactions such as weakness and weakness. They could only temporarily withdraw from the spell-casting array and regulate their breathing in place to suppress the restless evil energy in the body.

The Yin Yang Liao monk who controlled the illusion at the outermost edge frowned tightly. The large-scale psychedelic field that was spread was shattered and collapsed in the collision between the two forces. The power of the soul consumed in building the illusion was in vain. There were bursts of fatigue and soreness on the mental level. Reshaping the illusion again required more original mind.Everyone looked at each other, and everyone could see the solemn look in each other's eyes. They originally thought that they could easily crush the remaining enemies, but the reality of the battle continued to shift towards a stalemate, and the expected quick victory was completely in vain.

After a brief confrontation of forces, the violent air waves slowly dissipated, and the smoke and dust in the mountains and forests slowly settled. The ground was in a mess and dilapidated. Broken weapons, scattered charms, and broken leaves were all over the field of vision. The personnel on both sides stabilized their bodies, and the new round of close combat immediately connected seamlessly, without any room for breathing and rest.

Ninja Koga suppressed his anxiety and quickly adjusted his combat deployment. He gave up the large-scale collective attack mode and divided his ninjas into several small raiding teams. They cooperated in pairs and responded from far and near. Relying on dense forest trees and raised rocks as cover, they adopted the tactics of roaming raids and segmented harassment. They no longer resisted the team's joint defense head-on, but instead constantly searched for weak points in defense to launch tricky attacks.Several figures in black used the terrain to hide their figures, their footsteps landed lightly and silently, and their figures were erratic. From time to time, cold swords flashed out from between trees and behind rocks, and they stabbed at dead corners and injured areas around the team with precision. The attacks were cunning and insidious, making them impossible to guard against.

The Jiuju Onmyoji gave up the large-scale destruction spell bombardment and switched to the fine and continuous corrosive spell power. Thin blood-colored curse threads spread all over the sky like spider webs, constantly penetrating and approaching along the gaps in the air. They did not pursue instant heavy damage and kill the enemy, but continued to entangle and corrode the meridians, skin and flesh of the team members, bit by bit consuming the remaining physical strength and self-healing ability, and gradually disintegrating the foundation of the entire team's combat.Threads of cold evil energy cling to the clothes and skin, bringing biting coldness and slight corrosive pain, constantly disturbing everyone's mental stability.

The Yin Yang Lao monks learned from the experience of shattered illusions and no longer built giant illusions that covered the whole field. Instead, they split countless small confusing shadows and scattered them in every corner of the battlefield. Real and fake figures flashed alternately, constantly disrupting everyone's vision and judgment, and creating false attack sounds from time to time, forcing the team members to be frequently distracted and vigilant, needlessly consuming mental energy and dragging down the overall defensive rhythm.

Multiple tactics were applied layer by layer, and the fight in the Baishan Canyon instantly became intricate.The team was suffering from injuries and lacked strength. They could only rely on the rugged terrain under their feet and constantly move in misplaced positions according to the directions guided by Hu Jiulang. They always maintained a corresponding distance between each other, so that they could rescue each other without being surrounded and divided by the enemy's surprise force.

Yang Rui dragged his wounded body to the front of the formation, specifically to intercept the oncoming ninja team. Whenever a figure in black suddenly appeared, he gritted his teeth and mobilized the little strength left in his body to block and counterattack with heavy fists and feet.The power of annihilation was incomplete, and the power of the offensive was greatly reduced. He could not defeat the enemy with one blow, and could only rely on his strong physical resistance to withstand the blade stabs. New wounds were added to his skin and the blood-stained area continued to expand. Every time he punched or raised his feet, he had to endure extreme pain, but he always firmly guarded the first frontal line of defense, preventing the enemy from breaking through and approaching the core of the team.

Fan Mengxue moved around on the flanks, flexibly shuttled between trees and rocks, relied on her rich combat experience to predict the authenticity of phantoms, and promptly avoided the confusion of illusions and entanglement of curse threads. Once she found the enemy's offensive flaws, she immediately seized the short gap to get close to interfere, disrupting the enemy's attack rhythm, and sharing the pressure of frontal defense from the side.She did not dare to move too much for fear of tearing open more wounds. She advanced and retreated in a controlled manner between attack and defense, using clever maneuvers to consume the enemy's energy.

While always paying attention to Hu Jiulang's physical condition, Qian Dan glanced at the fighting points throughout the field. With the keen observation of a doctor, he quickly judged the changes in the severity of the enemy's injuries. At the same time, he picked up the small and sharp gravel dropped from the ground, and accurately threw it at the gaps between the enemy's meridians and acupuncture points. He used weak containment means to interfere with the enemy's spellcasting and moves, and did his best to block the enemy's attack.

The three girls on the inside each perform their duties. Wang Xinxin uses her remaining mental perception to eliminate the interference of false illusions and accurately indicate the location of the real enemy; Li Anqi senses the thin water vapor around her and condenses fine water droplets to block the evil spirit of the curse; Momo pays close attention to the movements on the ground, pays attention to the enemy's foot movements, and gives early warning of potential trap risks.

The three enemy forces took turns to launch attacks, with three attack methods: surprise attack, curse attack, and phantom disturbance. All members of the team gritted their teeth and held on to the defense line, blocking, dodging, containing, and counterattacking in cycles.Every collision of weapons will add new trauma, and every spell erosion will consume the remaining bodies. The number of enemy and friendly personnel has steadily shrunk, and more and more people have been injured. There are endless screams, clashing of weapons, and whispers of spells on the battlefield. Blood is constantly dripping and soaking in the rocks and soil. The entire White Mountain battlefield has accumulated injuries layer by layer, and the fighting has fallen into a long stalemate.

No one can easily break through the opponent's defensive line, and no one can gain an absolute crushing advantage. The trump card is still hidden, and the core combat power of the main force has not been fully exploded. The fierce fighting continues, and there is still a distance from the final decisive moment. The bloody game in the mountains and forests of Baishan is still escalating step by step.
